inputs.novelty_audit: research/control/stocks_free_v10_run/audits/d2_v10_novelty_measure.json (pooled Spearman midrank vs nine veto entries; control-identifiability rho; zero PnL)

selection_rubric_frozen_before_applicati: 1. MANDATORY LANE: at least one filing-timing (A4) proposal must be selected if any A4 proposal is eligible (PLAN sec2 axis 1 is the mandatory lane)

2. ELIGIBILITY GATES (measured, pre-selection): pooled |rho| <= 0.20 vs all nine veto entries AND anchor-vs-control |rho| strictly below the proposal's own declared gate (0.70 for A5-H1/A5-H2; 0.95 for A4-H1 anchor-vs-control; placebo-by-construction controls exempt from a rho gate but their measured rho is recorded)
3. COVERAGE RANK among eligible proposals: measured entity-decision pair count on the >= 63-bar pre-check universe
4. LANE DIVERSITY: the two selected families come from different lanes
5. BUDGET: at most two families x three arms = 6 scored cells (the cycle's entire budget); unused slots never reassigned

SFV10-A5-H1.verdict: ELIGIBLE (rho inside the declared 0.1-0.5 band, below the 0.70 gate)

SFV10-A5-H2.verdict: INELIGIBLE — DOUBLE-BLOCKED (novelty FAIL vs sector-exposure-form veto; control UNIDENTIFIABLE at 0.98 >= 0.70, exactly the proposal's own declared most-likely death point). Not rescuable, not reworded.

SFV10-A6-H1.verdict: ELIGIBLE on gates but THIN: 2,285 pairs (~76/decision) sits at the proposal's own pre-declared INFEASIBLE-risk floor for scored-decision minimums; not selected

SFV10-A6-H2.verdict: ELIGIBLE; not selected (coverage rank + lane diversity)

selection.rationale: rubric applied in order: (1) the mandatory filing-timing lane must appear — both A4 proposals are eligible, A4-H1 ranks higher on measured coverage (39,513 vs 27,134); (2) the highest-coverage eligible proposal overall is A5-H1 (43,501) from a different lane, satisfying diversity; A6 lanes are not selected under coverage rank + diversity; budget = 2 families x 3 arms = 6 cells, exactly the cycle budget
selection.implementation_spec: inherited 21-session grid (63+21k per fold), three frozen S0 folds, ALIVE+DEAD_PRICE_CONFIRMED legs with recorded exclusions, band cost model 10/15/25 bps stress x2 charged once per fill with L-I3 fail-closed resolution and C-rate exit ceiling, per-sector tercile net-zero books with >= 6-name sector floor, |Q| >= 4 breadth floor (A5) / latest-in-800d window as-of rule (A4), next-session fills, fill-check, dead-name exit at last close
